description: An elegant vintage-style party hairpiece designed with a soft white base topped with a delicate fabric flower, shiny pearl details, and light feathers. It is finished with a classic, wide-net birdcage veil that falls gently over the face for a timeless, royal look.
description2: It is lightweight, easy to clip into the hair, and holds securely for long events. This hairpiece can be customized in any color to perfectly match your dress.
